title: Crispy Fried Lettuce
description: Crispy Fried Lettuce is a delicate Chinese-style appetizer featuring fresh romaine or iceberg lettuce lightly coated in seasoned cornstarch and quickly deep-fried until crisp on the outside while remaining tender inside. A fragrant garlic and chili finish, with optional soy, oyster sauce, and sesame oil, adds savory depth without overpowering the fresh character of the lettuce.

ingredients.title: For the Lettuce
items: Romaine or iceberg lettuce – 1 medium head, firm and fresh

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Vegetable oil or peanut oil – 2–3 cups for deep-frying

ingredients.title: For the Aromatic Finish
items: Chili flakes or fresh chili – ½ tsp (optional)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Lettuce
steps: Wash the lettuce thoroughly and shake off any excess water.
Pat the lettuce completely dry with paper towels, as moisture can cause dangerous oil splattering.
Cut the lettuce into halves or quarters depending on its size, keeping the pieces reasonably intact for presentation.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Crispy Coating
steps: In a bowl, combine cornstarch, all-purpose flour if using, salt, and white pepper.
Lightly dust the lettuce pieces with the coating mixture.
Shake off excess coating so the lettuce remains light rather than heavily coated.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Heating the Oil
steps: Heat the vegetable or peanut oil in a wok or deep pan to 180°C (350°F).
Test the oil with a small piece of lettuce; it should sizzle immediately when added.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Frying the Lettuce
steps: Carefully place the coated lettuce pieces into the hot oil.
Fry in batches if necessary to prevent overcrowding.
Fry for approximately 10–15 seconds per side until lightly golden and crisp.
Remove the lettuce with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Aromatic Finish
steps: Heat 1 tsp oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and chili if using and cook briefly until fragrant.
Drizzle the aromatic mixture over the fried lettuce immediately.
Add a light drizzle of soy sauce, oyster sauce, or sesame oil if desired.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Serving
steps: Arrange the fried lettuce on a serving platter while hot and crisp.
Garnish with sesame seeds or finely sliced scallions if desired.
Serve immediately to preserve the crisp texture.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately as a crispy appetizer or side dish.
Pair with fried rice, noodles, or other Chinese stir-fried dishes.
Serve on a wide platter and garnish lightly with scallions or sesame seeds for an elegant presentation.

chefTips: Make sure the lettuce is completely dry before frying, as moisture can cause oil splattering and reduce crispness.
Use a high-smoke-point oil such as peanut or sunflower oil for quick, controlled frying.
Fry the lettuce very briefly; over-frying can make the leaves overly dark and lose their delicate texture.
Use only a light coating of cornstarch so the fried lettuce remains crisp and delicate rather than heavy.
Season lightly and allow the natural freshness of the lettuce to remain prominent.
Serve immediately because fried lettuce loses its crispness quickly after frying.
